notes.title: Historical Sites DLC!
notes.content:
Welcome to 2025!

This year, I plan to bring the game to the same standard as some of the more recent games I released, which include multi-step zoom, changeable background color, and so on. 

With this planned update, I'll also release a new DLC: Historical Sites. It will include three new levels: Notre Dame, Louvre and Palace of Versailles and 300 new cats. 

I can't tell you when exactly yet because I'm currently working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700540/Cats_Hidden_in_Japan/]Cats Hidden in Japan[/url] and afterwards I'll have to finish [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2951880/Cats_Hidden_Around_the_World_2/]Cats Hidden Around the World 2[/url] but I'm hoping to release the DLC and framework update this summer. 

Peace & Love
Patrick
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380510/Cats_Hidden_in_Paris__Historical_Sites/

notes.title: 2024 Review and Outlook 2025
notes.content:
This has been quite a year! Thank you everyone for playing my games! ❤️

I've released 25 levels with 2,500 hidden cats. Hundreds of thousands of you have played my games this year, a number which is simply unfathomable to me. I live a tranquil life in the countryside with limited social interactions outside of my family and I'm rarely active on social media. It's such a stark contrast. ^^

Additionally, there has been a new free level for Cats Hidden in Jingle Jam, a free game made together with Devcats, a complete remake of Cats Hidden in Georgia and countless other minor QoL updates across all games. Cats Hidden in Italy and Cats Hidden in Bali have also been released on Nintendo Switch! And another port is already in the works for quite some months. 

Here's a little overview of the games I released this year and further down some information abuot what's to come in 2025 and beyond.

[h1]February[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485180/

[h1]April[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2608040/

[h1]June[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2377970/

[h1]October[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2776570/

[h1]December[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2933990/



[h1]Coming 2025[/h1]

There will be less games in 2025. Right now, I have only two confirmed. 
The rest of the time, I want to spend updating the games that are already out. Like porting them to the improved framework with the multi-step zoom that is used by all the recent games to bring them all to the same level feature-wise.

Last but not least, I started working on a completely new game that is not a Hidden Object game but still situated in the Travellin Cats Universe. I hope to be able to release it in late 2025 but we'll see how it goes. 

Please wishlist the upcoming games if you haven't already. :)

[h1]Q1 2025[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700540/
[h1]Q2/Q3 2025[/h1]

notes.title: Community Items Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The almighty algorithm has decided we are worthy, so not only can the achievements now be showcased on your profile but I was also allowed to add community items: badges, emoticons and profile backgrounds. All of which can be found here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/2313250]Points Shop[/url]

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

The following update mainly contains bug fixes for people who play with a controller (1.20% of you! :D):

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where panning with 3x zoom active while playing with a controller would sometimes not scroll all the way to the edge of the picture.

[*]Fixed a bug where the back button on the top left would be visible when clicking on play with timer mode active after regularly finishing the game while using a controller.

[*]Fixed a bug with 3x zoom where upon finding the last cat it would jump straight to the fireworks without playing the trumpet sound and animation first.

[*]Unlocking timer mode now gets saved immediately upon finding the last cat to prevent losing progress if you close or ALT+F4 the game before returning to the menu.

[*]Some players mentioned the game closed unexpectedly. I couldn't figure out why, but I added one security measure to hopefully prevent that from happening. 

[*]Some players mentioned not all cat achievements had unlocked upon finishing the game, which sometimes could be caused by unstable internet connections. Upon finding the last cat, I added a check to unlock all 98 cat achievements. [/list]

Because of the recent updates to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/4145017/view/3700310527377680731]Steam's minimum price thresholds[/url], the DLC will be unavailable for sale in Australia until 7th September 2023.

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Over 2400 reviews in 3 days and 99% positive. I'm honestly speechless. Thank you! <3

EDIT: the speedrun achievement no longer exists.

The following changes are now live:

[list]
[*] Speedrun Achievement [b]time changed to 3min[/b]. This works retroactively, meaning if you achieved a time lower than 3min in the past, the achievement will unlock when you start the game again.
[*] The first time you play the second level (DLC), the timer mode gets deactivated because some were unaware that this can be done in the settings.
[*] Accidental clicking on zoom 2x/3x when going to settings is no longer possible.
[*] In-game screen position will now reset when changing zoom settings to prevent visual glitches.
[*] Fixed a minor bug where the level 2 button would appear while not being in the main menu upon purchase of the DLC while still having the game open.
[*] Fixed a minor bug where the in-game timer in the top right corner would display the times after 10min as 10:3 instead of 10:03.
[/list]

Peace & Love
Patrick

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

WOW! I did not expect such an overwhelmingly positive response from everyone! Thank you! <3

Also, thank you for all the feedback. Here is what this update brings:

[list]
[*] New Setting: switch between 2x or 3x zoom
[*] It's now possible to scroll down to the bottom while being zoomed out
[*] The birds can now also be clicked on while in timer mode
[*] Zooming is now immediately prevented upon finding the last cat to prevent some weird bug that Killerblue found. 
[/list]

When having 3x zoom active, there is no fancy transition but it just snaps in place when going back to 1x because I couldn't make it work otherwise. It was constantly glitching out. If one of you happens to be an expert with Clickteam Fusion 2.5 I'd be happy to take a look at the corresponding code section together. 

In case you're wondering why the level is just so slightly bigger than the screen, it is because my lovely artist drew the background in a different dimension than requested (and has since then disappeared). All future releases will be like the DLC: no scrolling is needed while zoomed out. ^^

That's about it for now. I hope this update didn't break anything. And if it did: please be patient with me. I am now going to sleep after a very very long day but I am looking forward to reading all new comments, messages and reviews when I wake up again. 

Peace & Love
Patrick
